form.label: AD Account & Computer Search
form.description: Search AD user accounts and computers (LDAP via SA-ldapsearch) and correlate with Windows Security events (Splunk_TA_windows). Click a row to drill down.

search.query: | ldapsearch domain="$domain$" search="(&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user)(!(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2048))(|(sAMAccountName=$acct$)(cn=$acct$)(displayName=$acct$)(mail=$acct$)(userPrincipalName=$acct$)))" attrs="sAMAccountName,cn,objectSid,displayName,userPrincipalName,mail,title,department,manager,userAccountControl,lockoutTime,lastLogonTimestamp,pwdLastSet,whenCreated,memberOf,distinguishedName" | eval lastLogon_e=strptime(lastLogonTimestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6NZ"), pwd_e=strptime(pwdLastSet,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6NZ"), lock_e=strptime(lockoutTime,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6NZ"), created_e=strptime(whenCreated,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%:z") | eval Status=case(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"ACCOUNTDISABLE")),"Disabled", lock_e>0,"Locked", true(),"Enabled") | eval PwdNeverExpires=if(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"DONT_EXPIRE_PASSWD")),"Yes","No") | eval PwdNotRequired=if(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"PASSWD_NOTREQD")),"Yes","No") | eval DaysSinceLogon=if(lastLogon_e>0,round((now()-lastLogon_e)/86400,0),"never") | eval PwdAgeDays=case(pwd_e>0,round((now()-pwd_e)/86400,0), pwdLastSet="(never)","must change", true(),"-") | eval Created=strftime(created_e,"%Y-%m-%d"), Manager=replace(mvindex(split(manager,","),0),"^CN=",""), Groups=coalesce(mvcount(memberOf),0), OU=replace(replace(replace(distinguishedName,"^.*?,(?=(OU|CN|DC)=)",""),",?DC=.*$$",""),"(OU|CN)=",""), OU=mvjoin(mvindex(split(OU,","),0,1)," < ")

| ldapsearch domain="$domain$" search="(&(objectClass=computer)(|(name=$comp$)(dNSHostName=$comp$)))" attrs="name,dNSHostName,operatingSystem,operatingSystemVersion,description,managedBy,userAccountControl,lastLogonTimestamp,whenCreated,distinguishedName" | eval lastLogon_e=strptime(lastLogonTimestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6NZ"), created_e=strptime(whenCreated,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%:z") | eval Status=if(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"ACCOUNTDISABLE")),"Disabled","Enabled") | eval Role=case(isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"SERVER_TRUST_ACCOUNT")),"Domain Controller", isnotnull(mvfind(userAccountControl,"PARTIAL_SECRETS_ACCOUNT")),"RODC", match(operatingSystem,"(?i)server"),"Server", isnull(operatingSystem),"Unknown", true(),"Workstation") | eval DaysSinceLogon=if(lastLogon_e>0,round((now()-lastLogon_e)/86400,0),"never") | eval Created=strftime(created_e,"%Y-%m-%d"), ManagedBy=replace(mvindex(split(managedBy,","),0),"^CN=",""), OU=replace(replace(replace(distinguishedName,"^.*?,(?=(OU|CN|DC)=)",""),",?DC=.*$$",""),"(OU|CN)=",""), OU=mvjoin(mvindex(split(OU,","),0,1)," < ") | fillnull value="-" operatingSystem operatingSystemVersion ManagedBy

| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Authentication where nodename=Authentication sourcetype="WinEventLog" (Authentication.signature_id=4624 OR Authentication.signature_id=4625) Authentication.user="*$acct$" (Authentication.dest="$comp$" OR Authentication.dest="$comp$.*") by _time span=1h Authentication.user Authentication.dest Authentication.src Authentication.action | rename Authentication.* AS * | eval user=lower(mvindex(split(mvindex(split(user,"@"),0),"\\"),-1)) | search user="$acct$" | where NOT like(user,"%$$") AND user!="-" AND lower(user)!="anonymous logon" AND user!="unknown" | eval dest_short=upper(mvindex(split(dest,"."),0)), Result=if(action="success","Success","Failure") | stats sum(count) AS count by _time user dest_short src Result

index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4771 OR EventCode=4776) user="$acct$" | eval code=lower(coalesce(Sub_Status,Failure_Code,Error_Code,"-")), Reason=case(EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4740,"-",code="0xc000006a" OR code="0x18","Bad password",code="0xc0000064" OR code="0x6","Unknown user",code="0xc0000234","Locked out",code="0xc0000072" OR code="0x12","Disabled/locked",code="0xc0000071" OR code="0x17","Password expired",code="0xc0000193","Account expired",code="0xc0000224","Must change password",code="0xc000006f","Outside logon hours",code="0xc0000070","Workstation restricted",true(),code) | where EventCode=4771 OR (code!="0x0" AND code!="-") | where NOT like(user,"%$$") AND user!="-" AND lower(user)!="anonymous logon" | eval user=lower(user), src=coalesce(src,Source_Network_Address,Workstation_Name,"-"), Protocol=if(EventCode=4771,"Kerberos","NTLM"), DC=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | bin _time span=1h | stats count by _time user src DC Protocol Reason
index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4740 user="$acct$" | eval k=user."|".floor(_time/60) | stats dc(k) AS count

| ldapsearch domain="$domain$" search="(&(objectClass=computer)(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=8192))" attrs="name,operatingSystem" | eval host=upper(name) | join type=left host [| tstats count latest(_time) AS last where index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-24h by host | eval host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | stats sum(count) AS count max(last) AS last by host] | eval Status=if(coalesce(count,0)>0,"Logging","NOT LOGGING"), Events24h=coalesce(count,0), LastEvent=if(isnull(last),"-",strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) | table name operatingSystem Status Events24h LastEvent | sort -Status name

html.h2: Validated SPL · LDAP (SA-ldapsearch) + WinEventLog:Security · click a row to drill down

search.query: | stats count
| where Status!="Enabled" | stats count
| where PwdNotRequired="Yes" AND Status!="Disabled" | stats count
| stats count
| where Result="Failure" | stats sum(count) AS count | fillnull value=0 count | appendpipe [stats count AS n | where n=0 | eval count=0 | fields count]
| stats sum(count) AS count | fillnull value=0 count | appendpipe [stats count AS n | where n=0 | eval count=0 | fields count]
| table count
| where Status="NOT LOGGING" | stats count
| eval _cn=cn, _sid=objectSid | table sAMAccountName displayName department title Status PwdNotRequired PwdNeverExpires DaysSinceLogon PwdAgeDays Groups OU _cn _sid | sort sAMAccountName

| search sAMAccountName="$sel_user$" | fields memberOf | mvexpand memberOf | eval Group=replace(mvindex(split(memberOf,","),0),"^CN=",""), Privileged=if(match(Group,"(?i)^(Domain Admins|Enterprise Admins|Schema Admins|Administrators|Account Operators|Backup Operators|Server Operators|Print Operators|DnsAdmins|Group Policy Creator Owners|Enterprise Key Admins|Key Admins)$"),"YES","-") | table Group Privileged | sort -Privileged Group

index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 user="$sel_user$" | eval dest_short=upper(mvindex(split(dest,"."),0)), src=coalesce(src,Source_Network_Address,Workstation_Name,"-") | eval LogonType=case(Logon_Type=2,"2 Interactive",Logon_Type=3,"3 Network",Logon_Type=4,"4 Batch",Logon_Type=5,"5 Service",Logon_Type=7,"7 Unlock",Logon_Type=8,"8 NetworkCleartext",Logon_Type=9,"9 NewCredentials",Logon_Type=10,"10 RemoteInteractive",Logon_Type=11,"11 CachedInteractive",isnotnull(Logon_Type),tostring(Logon_Type),true(),"-") | stats count AS Logons values(LogonType) AS LogonTypes dc(src) AS Sources max(_time) AS Last by dest_short | eval Last=strftime(Last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename dest_short AS Computer | sort -Logons
| search user="$sel_user$" | timechart span=1h sum(count) AS count by Result

index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4720,4722,4723,4724,4725,4726,4738,4740,4767,4728,4729,4732,4733,4756,4757) | eval target=lower(coalesce(user,mvindex(Account_Name,-1))), member_sid=if(mvcount(Security_ID)>=3,mvindex(Security_ID,1),"-") | where target=lower("$sel_user$") OR target=lower("$sel_cn$") OR member_sid="$sel_sid$" | eval Action=case(EventCode=4720,"Created",EventCode=4722,"Enabled",EventCode=4723,"Password change",EventCode=4724,"Password reset",EventCode=4725,"Disabled",EventCode=4726,"Deleted",EventCode=4738,"Changed",EventCode=4740,"Locked out",EventCode=4767,"Unlocked",EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=4756,"Added to group",EventCode=4729 OR EventCode=4733 OR EventCode=4757,"Removed from group") | eval By=coalesce(src_user,mvindex(Account_Name,0)), Group=coalesce(Group_Name,"-"), Caller=coalesce(Caller_Computer_Name,"-"), DC=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)), Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table Time Action By Group Caller DC EventCode | sort -Time | head 200

| eval name_u=upper(name) | lookup s1_agent_inventory.csv agent AS name_u OUTPUT LastSeen EDR_Version EDR_MachineType EDR_Network EDR_Infected EDR_Active EDR_Decommissioned EDR_ActiveThreats EDR_LastUser | eval EDR=case(isnull(LastSeen),"Missing", lower(EDR_Decommissioned)="true","Decommissioned", now()-LastSeen>7*86400,"Stale (>7d)", true(),"Installed"), EDR_SeenDays=if(isnull(LastSeen),"-",round((now()-LastSeen)/86400,0)) | table name Role operatingSystem Status DaysSinceLogon EDR EDR_Version EDR_SeenDays OU | sort name
| stats count by operatingSystem | sort -count

| where Status="Enabled" AND tonumber(DaysSinceLogon)<=$stale$ | eval name_u=upper(name) | lookup s1_agent_inventory.csv agent AS name_u OUTPUT LastSeen EDR_Version EDR_MachineType EDR_Network EDR_Infected EDR_Active EDR_Decommissioned EDR_ActiveThreats EDR_LastUser | eval EDR=case(isnull(LastSeen),"Missing", lower(EDR_Decommissioned)="true","Decommissioned", now()-LastSeen>7*86400,"Stale (>7d)", true(),"Installed"), EDR_SeenDays=if(isnull(LastSeen),"-",round((now()-LastSeen)/86400,0)) | stats count(eval(EDR="Installed")) AS ok count AS total | eval count=if(total>0,round(ok/total*100,1)."%","-") | table count

| where Status="Enabled" AND tonumber(DaysSinceLogon)<=$stale$ | eval name_u=upper(name) | lookup s1_agent_inventory.csv agent AS name_u OUTPUT LastSeen EDR_Version EDR_MachineType EDR_Network EDR_Infected EDR_Active EDR_Decommissioned EDR_ActiveThreats EDR_LastUser | eval EDR=case(isnull(LastSeen),"Missing", lower(EDR_Decommissioned)="true","Decommissioned", now()-LastSeen>7*86400,"Stale (>7d)", true(),"Installed"), EDR_SeenDays=if(isnull(LastSeen),"-",round((now()-LastSeen)/86400,0)) | where EDR!="Installed" | stats count

| eval name_u=upper(name) | lookup s1_agent_inventory.csv agent AS name_u OUTPUT LastSeen EDR_Version EDR_MachineType EDR_Network EDR_Infected EDR_Active EDR_Decommissioned EDR_ActiveThreats EDR_LastUser | eval EDR=case(isnull(LastSeen),"Missing", lower(EDR_Decommissioned)="true","Decommissioned", now()-LastSeen>7*86400,"Stale (>7d)", true(),"Installed"), EDR_SeenDays=if(isnull(LastSeen),"-",round((now()-LastSeen)/86400,0)) | where lower(EDR_Infected)="true" OR tonumber(EDR_ActiveThreats)>0 | stats count

table.title: Active computers (≤ $stale$ d) without healthy EDR — click a row

search.query: | where Status="Enabled" AND tonumber(DaysSinceLogon)<=$stale$ | eval name_u=upper(name) | lookup s1_agent_inventory.csv agent AS name_u OUTPUT LastSeen EDR_Version EDR_MachineType EDR_Network EDR_Infected EDR_Active EDR_Decommissioned EDR_ActiveThreats EDR_LastUser | eval EDR=case(isnull(LastSeen),"Missing", lower(EDR_Decommissioned)="true","Decommissioned", now()-LastSeen>7*86400,"Stale (>7d)", true(),"Installed"), EDR_SeenDays=if(isnull(LastSeen),"-",round((now()-LastSeen)/86400,0)) | where EDR!="Installed" | table name Role operatingSystem DaysSinceLogon EDR EDR_SeenDays OU | sort EDR -DaysSinceLogon name

| where Status="Enabled" AND tonumber(DaysSinceLogon)<=$stale$ | eval name_u=upper(name) | lookup s1_agent_inventory.csv agent AS name_u OUTPUT LastSeen EDR_Version EDR_MachineType EDR_Network EDR_Infected EDR_Active EDR_Decommissioned EDR_ActiveThreats EDR_LastUser | eval EDR=case(isnull(LastSeen),"Missing", lower(EDR_Decommissioned)="true","Decommissioned", now()-LastSeen>7*86400,"Stale (>7d)", true(),"Installed"), EDR_SeenDays=if(isnull(LastSeen),"-",round((now()-LastSeen)/86400,0)) | stats count AS Computers count(eval(EDR="Installed")) AS EDR_OK by Role | eval Coverage=round(EDR_OK/Computers*100,1)."%" | sort -Computers

| eval name_u=upper(name) | lookup s1_agent_inventory.csv agent AS name_u OUTPUT LastSeen EDR_Version EDR_MachineType EDR_Network EDR_Infected EDR_Active EDR_Decommissioned EDR_ActiveThreats EDR_LastUser | eval EDR=case(isnull(LastSeen),"Missing", lower(EDR_Decommissioned)="true","Decommissioned", now()-LastSeen>7*86400,"Stale (>7d)", true(),"Installed"), EDR_SeenDays=if(isnull(LastSeen),"-",round((now()-LastSeen)/86400,0)) | where lower(EDR_Infected)="true" OR tonumber(EDR_ActiveThreats)>0 | table name Role EDR_Infected EDR_ActiveThreats EDR_LastUser EDR_Network EDR_SeenDays

index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4624,4625) (dest="$sel_comp$" OR dest="$sel_comp$.*") | where NOT like(user,"%$$") AND user!="-" AND lower(user)!="anonymous logon" | eval user=lower(user), src=coalesce(src,Source_Network_Address,Workstation_Name,"-") | eval LogonType=case(Logon_Type=2,"2 Interactive",Logon_Type=3,"3 Network",Logon_Type=4,"4 Batch",Logon_Type=5,"5 Service",Logon_Type=7,"7 Unlock",Logon_Type=8,"8 NetworkCleartext",Logon_Type=9,"9 NewCredentials",Logon_Type=10,"10 RemoteInteractive",Logon_Type=11,"11 CachedInteractive",isnotnull(Logon_Type),tostring(Logon_Type),true(),"-") | stats count(eval(EventCode=4624)) AS Success count(eval(EventCode=4625)) AS Failure values(LogonType) AS LogonTypes dc(src) AS Sources max(_time) AS Last by user | eval Last=strftime(Last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort -Success

index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4741,4742,4743) user="$sel_comp$*" | where upper(replace(user,"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]",""))=upper("$sel_comp$") | eval Action=case(EventCode=4741,"Created",EventCode=4742,"Changed",EventCode=4743,"Deleted"), By=coalesce(src_user,mvindex(Account_Name,0)), DC=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)), Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table Time Action By DC EventCode | sort -Time | head 200

index="$edridx$" sourcetype="sentinelone:channel:applications" agentComputerName="$sel_comp$" earliest=-30d | stats latest(version) AS Version latest(publisher) AS Publisher latest(riskLevel) AS Risk latest(signed) AS Signed max(installedAt) AS InstalledAt by name | eval r=case(Risk="critical",4,Risk="high",3,Risk="medium",2,Risk="low",1,true(),0) | sort -r name | fields - r | rename name AS Application
| inputlookup s1_agent_inventory.csv where agent="$sel_comp$" | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | fields - agent | transpose 0 column_name=Field | rename "row 1" AS Value

| where Status="Enabled" AND (DaysSinceLogon="never" OR tonumber(DaysSinceLogon)>$stale$) | table sAMAccountName displayName department DaysSinceLogon PwdAgeDays PwdNeverExpires OU | sort -DaysSinceLogon
| where Status="Enabled" AND (DaysSinceLogon="never" OR tonumber(DaysSinceLogon)>$stale$) | table name Role operatingSystem DaysSinceLogon OU | sort -DaysSinceLogon
| where Result="Failure" | stats sum(count) AS Failures dc(dest_short) AS Targets dc(src) AS Sources by user | sort -Failures | head 20
| where Result="Failure" AND src!="unknown" | stats sum(count) AS Failures dc(user) AS Accounts dc(dest_short) AS Targets by src | where Accounts>=$spray$ | sort -Accounts | head 20
| stats sum(count) AS Failures dc(src) AS Sources values(Protocol) AS Protocol values(Reason) AS Reasons by user | sort -Failures | head 20
| stats sum(count) AS Failures dc(user) AS Accounts values(Protocol) AS Protocol values(Reason) AS Reasons by src | where Accounts>=$spray$ | sort -Accounts | head 20

index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4740 user="$acct$" | eval Caller=upper(coalesce(Caller_Computer_Name,"-")), k=user."|".floor(_time/60) | stats dc(k) AS Lockouts dc(user) AS Accounts values(user) AS Users max(_time) AS Last by Caller | eval Users=mvjoin(mvindex(Users,0,4),", "), Last=strftime(Last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort -Lockouts | head 20
| table *

table.title: Risky enabled accounts: PASSWD_NOTREQD / password never expires

search.query: | where Status!="Disabled" AND (PwdNotRequired="Yes" OR PwdNeverExpires="Yes") | table sAMAccountName displayName department Status PwdNotRequired PwdNeverExpires PwdAgeDays DaysSinceLogon OU | sort -PwdNotRequired sAMAccountName

table.title: Local group changes on servers (4732/4733 · T1098)

search.query: index="$idx$" source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4732,4733) (host="$comp$" OR host="$comp$.*") | eval member_sid=if(mvcount(Security_ID)>=3,mvindex(Security_ID,1),mvindex(Security_ID,-1)) | fields _time host EventCode Group_Name src_user Account_Name member_sid | append [| ldapsearch domain="$domain$" search="(objectClass=domain)" attrs="objectSid" | rename objectSid AS domain_sid | fields domain_sid] | eventstats values(domain_sid) AS domain_sid | where isnotnull(EventCode) | eval Action=if(EventCode=4732,"Added","Removed"), Server=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)), Group=coalesce(Group_Name,"-"), By=coalesce(src_user,mvindex(Account_Name,0)), Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), MemberType=case(match(member_sid,"^S-1-5-21-") AND replace(member_sid,"-\d+$$","")=domain_sid,"Domain account", match(member_sid,"^S-1-5-21-"),"Local / other domain", match(member_sid,"^S-1-5-32-"),"Builtin group", match(member_sid,"^S-1-5-"),"Well-known", true(),"Resolved name"), Privileged=if(match(Group,"(?i)^(Administrators|Remote Desktop Users|Backup Operators|Remote Management Users|Hyper-V Administrators|Event Log Readers)$$"),"YES","-") | table Time Server Action Group Privileged MemberType member_sid By $lgfilter$ | sort -Time | head 500

table.title: Risky applications across fleet (SentinelOne riskLevel ≠ none)

search.query: index="$edridx$" sourcetype="sentinelone:channel:applications" agentComputerName="$comp$" riskLevel!="none" | stats dc(agentComputerName) AS Computers values(version) AS Versions latest(publisher) AS Publisher latest(riskLevel) AS Risk by name | eval r=case(Risk="critical",4,Risk="high",3,Risk="medium",2,Risk="low",1,true(),0) | sort -r -Computers | fields - r | eval Versions=mvjoin(mvindex(Versions,0,4),", ") | rename name AS Application | head 100
